description: BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov is an open data portal listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics (USDOT). The Bureau of Transportation Statistics publishes the National Transportation Atlas Database as open layers and tables on roads, rail, transit, aviation, ports, waterways, pipelines, freight and safety, each with an ArcGIS feature service and download options. Coverage: United States. The catalogue lists 142 datasets, each with its own page, description and export options. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network and hazard studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
